payload.fault_isolation: Ingestion pipeline (VPS news-fetch -> proxy push -> DB) is FULLY GREEN. The ONLY failing component is the fetch_and_analyze MCP tool itself — the on-demand orchestration that fetches RSS + runs sentiment + impact-chains synchronously. It is heavy/slow and times out on its default ~20-item/4-source pull. Suspect: a single slow upstream (Reuters) blocking the whole synchronous batch, or a gateway/orchestration buffer/timeout budget too tight for the full pull.
payload.net_effect: Each off-hours news-scout cycle (0 */4) currently aborts its analysis stage. Background article ingestion still lands in the DB (fresh), but no sentiment scoring / impact-chain runs are produced for those cycles. Compounds MARKET-SLOTS-DARK (intraday news-scout already dark during market hours).

This is dev-team work (not dispatcher-spawnable from cowork lane).
